value: Geology and Mineral Resources of Nigeria - combined, EPSG:4326
NGSA Geological Map of Nigeria, 1:2,000,000 (2011 edition, DG Prof. Siyan Malomo); vector PDF, 125 layers
NGSA Mineral Resources Map of Nigeria, 1:2,000,000, 2nd edition 2023 (DG Dr Abdulrazaq Garba); vector PDF
affine fitted to printed 1-degree graticule: lon = (x + 276.36)/157.593, lat = (2281.63 - y)/157.586; residual 0.20 pt
affine fitted to printed graticule (not the embedded /Measure, which disagrees with it): lon = (x + 288.67)/157.288, lat = (2575.87 - y)/157.602
Both sheets are unprojected equirectangular at 157.6 pt/deg = 1:2,000,000; datum treated as WGS 84 (Minna datum would shift ~100-200 m, below drawing resolution)
1 pt = 0.7 km on the ground; graticule fit <0.3 pt; residual cartographic disagreement between the two sheets ~5 km median, 20 km p90
geology polygons total 924,900 km2 vs 923,768 km2 official - +0.1%
No attribute tables exist in either PDF; codes, strata and ages were reconstructed from layer names, the printed legend and in-polygon labels

26 layers, 13,397 features: 5 geology (units in 4326/32632/6933, boundaries, faults, fold axes, plugs, granite outlines), 4 water/boundary (water_bodies, rivers, national_territory, international_boundary), 7 mineral (localities in 3 CRS, icons in 2, refined, symbols), 10 base geography + 2 QA graticules. Full per-layer description in README.md, machine-checked in layer_audit.json

audit_layers.py verifies all 26 layers: 0 invalid/empty/null geometries, 0 unexplained duplicate geometries, 0 point-to-unit join mismatches, area identical to 0.000 % between EPSG:4326 / 6933 / geodesic, 2023 border within 7.5 m of the geology edge. Run it after any rebuild

the 2011 legend has 92 rows but 87 codes: Esh, MS, MyP, Ncsh and Wss are printed twice, each row a different rock. Units are resolved per legend row, so the geology carries 96 rows (95 rock units + W water); the split units are CODE and CODE_<row>. attr_source says legend vs in-map label

the 2011 sheet draws neighbouring-country context: 16.9 % of rivers, 7.6 % of roads, 7.7 % of state boundaries and 23 of 486 towns lie outside the border. Kept and flagged per feature (frac_in_nigeria on lines, in_nigeria on points)
